employee_role.name: employee_role
employee_role.value: "erp_private"."employees"."role" in ('Super Admin','Managing Director','Accounts','Import Officer','Warehouse Manager','Sales Manager','Sales Executive')

expense_amount.name: expense_amount
expense_amount.value: "erp_private"."expenses"."amount" > 0 and (("erp_private"."expenses"."subtype" = 'General' and "erp_private"."expenses"."ta_amount" is null and "erp_private"."expenses"."da_amount" is null) or ("erp_private"."expenses"."subtype" = 'TA/DA' and "erp_private"."expenses"."expense_for" = 'Employee' and "erp_private"."expenses"."ta_amount" is not null and "erp_private"."expenses"."da_amount" is not null and "erp_private"."expenses"."ta_amount" >= 0 and "erp_private"."expenses"."da_amount" >= 0 and "erp_private"."expenses"."amount" = "erp_private"."expenses"."ta_amount" + "erp_private"."expenses"."da_amount"))

expense_employee.name: expense_employee
expense_employee.value: ("erp_private"."expenses"."expense_for" = 'Employee' and "erp_private"."expenses"."employee_id" is not null) or ("erp_private"."expenses"."expense_for" in ('Office','Warehouse','Company / General') and "erp_private"."expenses"."employee_id" is null)

position_category.name: position_category
position_category.value: "erp_private"."financial_position_entries"."category" in ('Owner Capital','Fixed Assets','Accumulated Depreciation','Statutory Payables','Other Receivables','Other Payables','Opening Retained Earnings')

import_status.name: import_status
import_status.value: "erp_private"."import_cases"."status" in ('Draft','PI Received','LC/TT Opened','In Production','Shipped','At Port','Costing','Cost Finalized','Partially Received','Received','Closed','Cancelled')

import_item_nonnegative.name: import_item_nonnegative
import_item_nonnegative.value: "erp_private"."import_items"."quantity" > 0 and "erp_private"."import_items"."fob_unit_foreign" >= 0 and "erp_private"."import_items"."exchange_rate" >= 0 and "erp_private"."import_items"."fob_total_bdt" >= 0 and "erp_private"."import_items"."total_cbm" >= 0 and "erp_private"."import_items"."carton_count" >= 0 and "erp_private"."import_items"."cbm_per_carton" >= 0

activity_subject.name: activity_subject
activity_subject.value: not ("erp_private"."marketing_activities"."customer_id" is not null and "erp_private"."marketing_activities"."lead_id" is not null)

follow_up_subject.name: follow_up_subject
follow_up_subject.value: ("erp_private"."marketing_follow_ups"."customer_id" is not null)::integer + ("erp_private"."marketing_follow_ups"."lead_id" is not null)::integer = 1

target_values.name: target_values
target_values.value: "erp_private"."marketing_targets"."sales" >= 0 and "erp_private"."marketing_targets"."collections" >= 0 and "erp_private"."marketing_targets"."customers" >= 0 and "erp_private"."marketing_targets"."activities" >= 0 and "erp_private"."marketing_targets"."visits" >= 0 and extract(day from "erp_private"."marketing_targets"."month") = 1

supplier_settlement_values.name: supplier_settlement_values
supplier_settlement_values.value: "erp_private"."supplier_settlements"."amount" > 0 and (("erp_private"."supplier_settlements"."entry_type" = 'Payment' and "erp_private"."supplier_settlements"."account_id" is not null and "erp_private"."supplier_settlements"."transaction_id" is not null) or ("erp_private"."supplier_settlements"."entry_type" = 'Obligation' and "erp_private"."supplier_settlements"."account_id" is null and "erp_private"."supplier_settlements"."transaction_id" is null))
